question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is feasible within the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index lifecycle policy, and overlaps with external plugin/reranker directions.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer to external plugin or ClawHub
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and document advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior as an external package path.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Close the feature direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.
